🚨 Gemini 4 Carbon (gemini-4-carbon) has officially entered Google internal teamfooding.

Google quietly overwrote the Antigravity ACP v1.4.3 archive in-place on dl.google.com without bumping the version number — growing the internal Discovery Doc by +13,725 bytes (459 → 464 active models).

New identifiers added in the drop:
• gemini-4-carbon (M427)
• gemini-4-carbon-teamfood (M428)
• carbon-g-medium-tf (M435)
• gemini-4-argon-teamfood (M426)
• gemini-4-argon-max-mode-tf (M436)

Carbon + Argon Max Mode are both live internally 👀
